_comment: Filed at adjudication, not at completion (owner, 2026-10-30, option E on cat-harness#686): a spec-kit spec's success criteria become criterion keys here with `status: proposed`, so a test plan can cite `req:model-benchmark#<statement>/SC-NNN` before the feature ships. Graduation flips `status` to `in-force`. Spec: cat-harness#686 (beans folio-assistant-amom, folio-assistant-oz9e, epic 5a3l). FR-011 (ARG-Designer comparability) was dropped at adjudication.
title: Models and configurations can be compared on one test plan, honestly
description: The test process (arc 3fva: test-plan/v1, folio-test-run/v1, test-report/v1) is extended so one plan can be run against several systems under test, each a model plus a configuration, and the results set side by side. Runs are manual for now, cost is never invented, a benchmark never writes to beans/, and fixed machine findings become test cases with known answers.

statements.label: An agent under test names its model and configuration
statements.requirement: A folio-test-run/v1 record's system under test SHALL say its kind. An agent SHALL carry a model (a ModelIdSchema id) and a named configuration (at least "harness" or "bare"), and an agent's run record without a model SHALL be refused. A system of any other kind runs deterministic code and SHALL name no model (owner, 2026-10-30, FR-002 option A; FR-001, FR-002).

successCriteria.criterion: Every agent run record without a model is refused when validated, and a model on any other kind is refused.

statements.label: One plan, N systems, one side-by-side report
statements.requirement: The test process SHALL run one plan against N systems under test and report each case's verdicts side by side, and SHALL refuse a comparison whose systems under test do not differ (FR-003, FR-004).

successCriteria.criterion: One report compares one plan across at least two models and two configurations.

statements.label: Missing cost reads unknown
statements.requirement: A run SHALL accept optional tokens in, tokens out, wall-clock time and cost, and a missing value SHALL read unknown, never 0 (FR-005).

successCriteria.criterion: No report shows a cost of 0 where no cost was recorded.

statements.label: An independent-queue run leaves beans/ alone
statements.requirement: An independent-queue benchmark run SHALL NOT create or change anything under beans/ (FR-006).

successCriteria.criterion: After an independent run over N systems, beans/ is byte-identical to before.

statements.label: Every benchmark run is asked for
statements.requirement: Every benchmark run SHALL be asked for, with its own estimate, before it starts, and no trigger SHALL start one on a schedule (FR-007).

successCriteria.criterion: No benchmark run record exists without an approval that precedes it and carries an estimate.

statements.label: Fixed machine findings become test cases
statements.requirement: A generator SHALL turn script QA findings that a later commit fixed into test-plan/v1 cases, citing the finding and the before and after commits, and SHALL emit nothing for agent or human findings (FR-008).

successCriteria.criterion: The generator yields at least one case from the real history under test/results/.

statements.label: A plan can cite a proposed requirement's criteria
statements.requirement: A test plan's requirements[] SHALL accept a req: reference to a proposed requirement's statement or criterion, so a spec's success criteria are testable before graduation (FR-009, as adjudicated 2026-10-30: no separate spec: id form).

successCriteria.criterion: A plan citing req:model-benchmark#side-by-side/SC-001 validates, and one citing a malformed reference is refused.

statements.label: Results are a test report, not graph content
statements.requirement: A benchmark's result SHALL be a test-report/v1 in qa-reports, and nothing SHALL be added to a folio's graph (FR-010).

successCriteria.criterion: A benchmark run changes no file under a folio's declared graph paths.
